Container.Name: unraid-mcp
Container.Overview:
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes this Unraid server to AI agents via the official Unraid GraphQL API.
Read-only by default (system, array, disks, parity, Docker, VMs, shares, notifications, UPS, network). Mutating tools are registered only when UNRAID_MCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS is true, and every mutation requires confirm=true.
Runs the streamable-HTTP transport on port 6750. MCP clients connect to http://TOWER-IP:6750/mcp and must send "Authorization: Bearer <UNRAID_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN>". The transport is stateless (MCP spec 2026-07-28): no session affinity is needed behind a reverse proxy or load balancer, and restarting the container between client requests is safe.
SETUP: 1) Create an API key on Unraid: Settings -> Management Access -> API Keys (a guest/read-only role is enough for monitoring). 2) Set UNRAID_API_URL to this server's GraphQL endpoint using a hostname that matches the cert, e.g. https://yourhash.myunraid.net/graphql. 3) Set a long random UNRAID_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN (for example, openssl rand -hex 32). Put the container behind a TLS reverse proxy (or set UNRAID_MCP_TLS_CERT/KEY) before exposing it beyond your LAN.
The image has a built-in Docker HEALTHCHECK that polls the unauthenticated GET /health liveness endpoint (no bearer token needed, no call to the Unraid API), so the container's health shows up in Unraid's Docker tab without any extra configuration.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Streamable-HTTP port. Clients connect to http://TOWER-IP:<port>/mcp.

Config.Name: Unraid API URL
Config.Description: GraphQL endpoint of THIS Unraid server. Use a hostname that matches the cert, e.g. https://yourhash.myunraid.net/graphql. LAN IP URLs usually require Verify Unraid TLS=false unless the cert includes that IP.

Config.Name: Unraid API Key
Config.Description: API key from Settings -> Management Access -> API Keys. A guest/read role suffices for monitoring.

Config.Name: MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Token MCP clients must send (Authorization: Bearer ...). Must be at least 32 random characters; generate with: openssl rand -hex 32.

Config.Name: Verify Unraid TLS
Config.Description: Verify the Unraid API certificate. A CA bundle can trust a self-signed cert but cannot fix hostname/IP mismatch; only set false on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Unraid CA Bundle
Config.Description: Optional PEM CA bundle path inside the container for the Unraid API certificate, e.g. /certs/unraid-ca.pem.

Config.Name: Allow Mutations
Config.Description: Register state-changing tools (start/stop array, Docker/VM control, notifications). Each still requires confirm=true. Keep false for monitoring only.

Config.Name: Allow Raw GraphQL Query
Config.Description: Register a read-only raw GraphQL passthrough tool (mutations/subscriptions rejected).

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated Host allow-list for DNS-rebinding protection. Include the LAN IP/name clients use, e.g. tower.local:6750,10.0.0.5:6750.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log level (stderr): DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.
